title: AI Overviews
content: AI Overviews are AI-generated summaries that Google shows for some searches, with links to supporting pages.

meta.why: AI Overviews give a reader another place to meet an explanation, or a business, before visiting any website.
meta.example: A search for a technical term displays a short explanation and links to pages used to support it.
meta.check: Record whether an overview appears for a relevant search and which pages it links to. Keep the date and the query with each observation.
meta.limitation: Google does not show an overview for every query, and a page that is eligible can still be left out.
meta.sources: Google Search Central: AI features and your website | https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/ai-features | Platform documentation
